findings.problem: The hint doesn't single out fassen, because fangen, schnappen, erwischen and festnehmen are all common German words for catching a criminal, and fangen is the first one most people would give.
findings.fix: hint: a criminal, said of the police; not fangen, schnappen or festnehmen

back.target: to grab, to take hold of; to catch, apprehend (a criminal); to grasp (an idea)
back.example: The police caught the thief yesterday.

note: The new hint must stay clearly different from the other card's hint, "to grasp" (to take in, believe), so the two meanings aren't confused.
